subject: Promo codes for DevBootcamp livestream - attendee incentives

To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo codes for DevBootcamp livestream - 3k attendees

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the quick intro call earlier. NodeLabs is running DevBootcamp (virtual livestream + breakout clinics) on Nov 4-6 and we expect ~3k registrants, ~1.2k live attendees. We'd love to offer a small incentive to registrants — a trial extension or promo credit to try Redwood for post-event projects.

Request: 250 promo codes (single-use) worth $50 credit each, redeemable via self-serve sign-up. Ideally the codes expire 2027-02-28. We'll distribute codes to workshop attendees and include Redwood in our partner slide during peaks.

Can you confirm feasibility, any contract/PO required, and an ETA to deliver a code .tsv? Also happy to add Redwood to our sponsor page/announcement if there's a marketing asset.

Best,
Asha Rao
Partnerships Lead, NodeLabs Events

Hi Asha — really excited about DevBootcamp, sounds like a great audience.

Short answers:
- 250 single-use $50 promo codes is doable from our side.
- Codes can be set to expire 2027-02-28.
- Standard partner MOU is typical for sponsor placements; I can share a one-page MOU (no-cost) for approvals.
- We can ship a TSV of codes and a one-line activation instruction that NodeLabs can paste in emails.

I'm looping in Marissa on the marketing and distribution details. Marissa — would Redwood be open to a sponsor mention + partner slide in exchange for the codes? Any constraints on how we surface the free credits in external comms? Also, do we need a PO for 250 x $50 promo ($12,500 notional) or can we approve via partner credits budget?

Asha — give me a sense of timing. If you need codes by Oct 9 we can prioritize.

Cheers,

Thanks for the ping. Quick internal notes:
- Marketing is fine with a sponsor mention + 1 partner slide in exchange for the codes. Please share the partner blurb/logo spec (PNG/SVG).
- Finance requires either a partner credit allocation approval or a PO for accounting. For small tactical credit grants we usually approve via partner budget up to $15k without a PO. This qualifies.
- Please confirm redemption constraints: single-use per account, new accounts only, and credit applied to API usage (not transferable).

Vivek — can you confirm code generation process and TTL? Also, do we want to gate by email domain (no) or coupon-only redemption? NodeLabs needs a simple self-serve flow.

@Asha: if that works, I'll mark as approved and Jordan can produce the TSV.
